criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Delivery
categories.definition: Inquiries about the delivery status or timing of a new or replacement card.

categories.name: Card Activation
categories.definition: Questions about how to activate a new or replacement card.

categories.name: Card Usage Issues
categories.definition: Problems with using a card for payments, including declines and contactless issues.

categories.name: Card Lost or Stolen
categories.definition: Reports of lost or stolen cards and requests to freeze or replace them.

categories.name: PIN Issues
categories.definition: Inquiries about finding, changing, or unblocking a card PIN.

categories.name: Account Closure
categories.definition: Requests to delete or close an account.

categories.name: Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Problems with making or receiving transfers, including pending or failed transfers.

categories.name: Transfer Fees
categories.definition: Questions about fees associated with making transfers.

categories.name: Top-Up Issues
categories.definition: Problems with topping up an account, including failed or pending top-ups.

categories.name: Top-Up Methods
categories.definition: Inquiries about the methods available for topping up an account.

categories.name: Cash Withdrawal Issues
categories.definition: Problems with withdrawing cash from an ATM, including incorrect amounts or fees.

categories.name: Refunds
categories.definition: Inquiries about refunds for purchases or transactions.

categories.name: Fraud and Unauthorized Transactions
categories.definition: Reports of unauthorized transactions or suspected fraud on an account.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Questions about exchanging currencies, including rates and fees.

categories.name: Virtual Cards
categories.definition: Inquiries about obtaining or using virtual or disposable virtual cards.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Issues or questions related to verifying identity for account access or transactions.

categories.name: Account Information
categories.definition: Requests to change or update account details, such as name or contact information.

categories.name: Account Balance and Transactions
categories.definition: Questions about account balance, transaction history, or the source of funds.

categories.name: Card Fees
categories.definition: Inquiries about fees associated with card usage, such as ATM or transaction fees.

categories.name: Payment Reversals
categories.definition: Questions about payments that have been reversed or returned.

categories.name: Account Access Issues
categories.definition: Problems accessing an account, including passcode or app login issues.

categories.name: Child Accounts
categories.definition: Inquiries about setting up or managing accounts for children.

categories.name: Card Options
categories.definition: Questions about the types of cards available, such as Visa or Mastercard.

categories.name: Auto Top-Up
categories.definition: Inquiries about setting up or managing automatic top-ups for an account.
